# Amazfit

> > Amazfit is a global smart wearables brand by Zepp Health, offering GPS fitness watches and health monitoring devices powered by the Zepp App ecosystem.

Amazfit specializes in rugged outdoor smartwatches like the T-Rex series, running-focused devices like the Cheetah Pro, and lifestyle trackers like the Balance and Active models. The brand integrates with Zepp Coach for AI-powered training and Zepp Aura for sleep wellness, serving athletes and fitness enthusiasts worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Amazfit smartwatches
- Zepp App and Zepp Health ecosystem
- GPS tracking and fitness monitoring
- Battery life optimization
- Amazfit T-Rex series (rugged outdoor watches)
- Amazfit Cheetah Pro (running performance)
- Amazfit Balance and Active (lifestyle fitness)
- Firmware updates and feature enhancements
- Heart rate and health monitoring
- Zepp Coach (AI training)
- Zepp Aura (sleep and wellness)
- 10ATM water resistance
- Workout extensions and sports modes
- Athlete ambassadors and partnerships
- Sustainable accessories

## Smartwatch Products

- [Amazfit Active Edge](https://www.amazfit.com/products/amazfit-active-edge): Active Edge: dual-color GPS watch, 14-day battery, 10ATM water-resistant
- [Zepp Aura Gift Cards](https://www.amazfit.com/products/zepp-aura-gift-cards): Zepp Aura subscription gift cards for sleep tracking and AI wellness
- [Amazfit Upcycled Silicone Strap](https://www.amazfit.com/products/amazfit-upcycled-silicone-strap): Eco-friendly upcycled silicone strap for Balance, Cheetah Pro watches
